Hi Tanya —

Thanks again for taking the SOC 2 intake call last week. To keep the audit team moving I put together a compact ask list focused on access control and provisioning artifacts we typically provide. Can you confirm the acceptance window (we're targeting 7/3 delivery on your side) and whether any of the items below need additional redaction?

Requested items (short deliverable set):
- Role / group inventory (current active roles + owners) — csv/xlsx
- Sample SAML assertion (2-3 recent assertions, anonymized) — xml
- SCIM delta logs (48-72 hr excerpt around a provisioning window) — log file
- Evidence of least-privilege mapping for service accounts (summary doc or table)
- Name and contact for the person who can confirm SCIM attribute mappings

We'll provide a secure share link and, if helpful, a checklist mapping these artifacts to common SIG/SOC questions. Attachments from our side will include an index and a minimal mapping template you can drop artifacts into.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_index_v1.pdf (stub)

Suggested next steps:
1) If you can confirm which artifacts you can pull, reply here.
2) If you prefer, we can accept a secure SFTP/Drive drop — tell us your preference.
3) If redaction is required (PII/PHI), note which fields to redact and we'll accept a masked sample.

Thanks — we aim to minimize your lift here.

Best,

Mina —

Thanks for the clear checklist. A few clarifying items from InfoSec side: 

1) SAML assertions — we need at least two assertions taken from normal user login flows and one from a service-account or scheduler context. Anonymization is fine, but the assertions must preserve the raw attribute names and timestamps.

2) SCIM excerpt — the audit team prefers a delta around an explicit provisioning job; 6/28–6/29 or 6/29–6/30 is fine. Please redact email addresses and replace with tokens (user_001).

3) Role inventory — can you include the mapping to any permission sets or policies that reference AWS/GCP roles? We expect a column that lists platform bindings where applicable.

4) Least-privilege evidence — a one-page narrative describing how service accounts are scoped and reviewed quarterly is acceptable if a full attestation is not available.

We can take a Drive drop at the link you provide; alternatively, we can accept the files via our secure upload portal (procurement provided earlier).

We'll plan a short handoff call Thurs 7/3 at 10:00 AM PT if that works for you — send an invite if so.

Regards,
Tanya Reed
Information Security Manager
Aurora Health
